title: Docked media card that grows into its section
summary: A fixed card docked bottom right, scaled (transform only, `transform-origin` bottom right) from `300 px` to the viewport minus the gutter between `top 85%` and `top top` of its section, linear `scrub: true`, then swapped from `position: fixed` to the section's flow where the two boxes coincide; unscaled cue link fades out, desktop only (≥ 1024 px), CSS placeholder film so no media ships, full-size in its section under reduced motion
variants: fixed card scaled from its bottom-right corner to the section box, handed to the flow at the end (this, default)
muted playsinline <video> as the reel, paused on its poster under reduced motion and off-screen
reverse: a full-frame reel scrubbed down into a small frame as its section leaves
